policy.routineReleaseGate: Use audit:constitution for fixed, fast compiler and package-safety proof.
policy.broadRegression: Use audit:gold for scheduled broad regression, large compiler or generator changes, release-candidate hardening, or constitution-level changes.
policy.liveGeneration: Use live EduTool.dev generations to discover new defects, not to re-prove every commit.

principles.name: Course Identity Coherence
principles.obligation: The package preserves one clear course identity across manifest, artifacts, quality report, and handoff surfaces.

principles.name: Complete Package Structure
principles.obligation: Requested features, manifest file rows, root audit files, and exported files agree.

principles.name: Assessment Coverage
principles.obligation: Course-map assessments resolve to downstream artifacts or an explicit in-class-only caveat.

principles.name: Source And Caveat Honesty
principles.obligation: Digest caveats that affect instructor trust are disclosed in the manifest or quality report.

principles.name: Discipline And Modality Fit
principles.obligation: Assets, examples, activities, and safety language fit the declared course discipline and modality.

principles.name: Artifact Substance
principles.obligation: Artifacts are instructor-usable drafts, not title-only files, placeholders, or repeated generic shells.

principles.name: Clear Handoff
principles.obligation: Final handoff surfaces make grade, findings, caveats, and next review actions legible.
